captions:
Just a quick look before the rush starts.
Isla eyes her growing to-do list, but pauses to give the puzzle one steady look first.

No point in stressing over a delayed train.
As the train falls behind schedule, she resists the urge to close her screen and panic.

The world can wait for three minutes.
Ignoring a flashing notification, Isla claims three three minutes for herself at the outdoor table.

Check the daily rule before trusting it.
The daily rule changes the move, so Isla checks it before trusting the answer.

Slow and steady really does work.
Her deliberate pace pays off, turning her mountain of chores into simple, manageable steps.

I need to protect this time tomorrow, too.
Gathering her things, Isla realizes that keeping these steady morning rituals is how she resets her mind.
